build_GeneralizedRCNN: build a GeneralizedRCNN model from a config that includes backbone, RPN, and ROI heads
run_GeneralizedRCNN_forward_training: run the GeneralizedRCNN forward pass in training mode with images and targets to get losses
run_GeneralizedRCNN_forward_inference: run the GeneralizedRCNN forward pass in inference mode with images to get detections and masks
review_GeneralizedRCNN_architecture: review the GeneralizedRCNN class architecture consisting of backbone, RPN, and ROI heads components
refactor_GeneralizedRCNN_forward: refactor the GeneralizedRCNN forward method to handle RPN-only models without ROI heads
